title: Consolidated Savings Replay Notebook — staged dry‑run + auditable apply ledger
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Problem: Customers are asking for a single, auditable place in Console where they can review automated batching/caching recommendations, run a safe rehearsal of changes against historical traffic, and apply or rollback configs with a clear, exportable trail. Current recommendation cards and diffs live in disparate panes and lack a compact, time-ordered ledger for audits and SRE reviews.

Goal: Build a "replay notebook" concept in Optimize that consolidates recommendation diffs, a dry‑run replay against sampled traffic (no live apply), and a one-click safe apply flow that records an immutable audit entry with snapshot, actor, rationale, and linked rollback op. UX should fit into Console with minimal clutter and be reviewable by security/compliance teams.

Scope: MVP will include: 1) a unified summary row per recommendation with cost/latency delta estimates and confidence band, 2) a staged-dry-run mode that replays changes against a configurable window of historical requests (sampled) producing an artifacts snapshot, 3) an apply workflow that creates an immutable ledger entry (snapshot + diff + operator) and an automatic rollback stub (revert button) with role-gated controls.

Out of scope: full-fidelity simulators across all model types, end-to-end canary rollout automation (handled by Runtime rollout workstream).
acceptance_criteria: A consolidated 'Replay Notebook' tab exists under Optimize > Recommendations that lists staged recommendations in time order
Each entry shows: recommendation summary, estimated monthly savings, expected P95 latency impact, confidence score, and an inline diff preview with token-level cost delta

Users can run a 'Staged Dry‑Run' that replays the config against a sampled 24h window and stores a read-only snapshot (artifacts: simulated token counts, failed-ratio, cost delta) visible in the notebook

Applying a recommendation creates an immutable ledger entry with operator name, timestamp, snapshot ID, linked PR/Runbook, and a one-click 'Prepare rollback' artifact that can be executed by an operator with correct RBAC
All ledger entries are exportable as CSV/JSON and visible in Console audit logs; read permissions respect org RBAC
Security review checklist completed and stakeholders (security/compliance) have signed off on snapshot storage and KMS usage for artifacts

notes: Trade-offs considered: full-fidelity simulation (more accurate) vs. sampled dry-run (faster, cheaper). Chose sampled dry-run to keep MVP latency/compute reasonable and reduce storage needs.
Rollout plan: Beta for customers on Dedicated and Hosted Plus tiers, opt-in for orgs until audit signoff and RBAC mapping complete.
Observability: each dry-run generates telemetry that feeds Optimize 'quality monitors' so regressions can be auto-flagged in future iterations.
